_comment: Hand-written roles for kernel tunables in docs/inventory/tunable-summary.tsv. Each entry gives a grade (established: the read sites were read in the disassembly and the statements about them are mechanical; inferred: the meaning of the value is reasoned from the code around it), a role in plain words, and a citation naming the 6.5.30 kernel and the routine and address of the sites. A row counts as understood only with all three. Keys are tunable names. Sites that the symbolic pass did not find are stated as absent, not as unused. A role applies to the kernels in its kernels list (IP27 only where the IP35 and IP30 sites are listed but not traced); other kernels stay located.

numa_migr_default_mode.role: Default page-migration mode, a small integer. In IP27 migr_control_init loads it at 0xc0000000002815dc (the word at 0xc0000000014ca8b4) and compares it with 0, 1, 3, 2 and 4 in turn (beq chain); each value runs one arm that updates a flag byte in a per-node record, and any other value falls to a cmn_err call at 0xc000000000282194 with the first argument set to 4 in the branch delay slot. mem_tick_init_node reads the low byte of the word (symbol+3, lbu at 0xc00000000027a744) and branches on zero. IP35 has one word load in migr_control_init (0xc00000000032e068) that is not traced further. IP30 has no read site.
numa_migr_default_mode.citation: 6.5.30 unix.IP27 migr_control_init (0xc000000000281558; compare chain 0xc000000000281608 region, default arm 0xc000000000282194) and mem_tick_init_node (0xc00000000027a424; lbu at 0xc00000000027a744); unix.IP35 migr_control_init (0xc00000000032dfe8; load 0xc00000000032e068)

numa_migr_default_threshold.role: Default migration threshold, an integer that must lie in 0 to 100. In IP27 migr_control_init loads it at 0xc0000000002816dc and branches to 0xc000000000281ecc (a cmn_err error arm) when it is negative (bltz) or 101 or more (slti 101, beq). The value is used only on the accepted path, which is not traced. No read site in IP35 or IP30 was found by the symbolic pass; the IP35 gp-relative offset of the symbol has no access.
numa_migr_default_threshold.citation: 6.5.30 unix.IP27 migr_control_init (load 0xc0000000002816dc, error arm 0xc000000000281ecc); unix.IP35 migr_control_init (no site)

numa_migr_threshold_reference.role: Selector for the migration threshold reference, with values 0 and 1 handled as separate arms. In IP27 migr_control_init loads it at 0xc00000000028169c, branches to 0xc000000000281de0 when it is zero, and to 0xc0000000002820e8 when it differs from the constant 1 held in s2. The arm for value 1 is not traced. No read site in IP35 or IP30.

numa_migr_vehicle.role: Migration vehicle selector, a small integer. migr_control_init stores the constant 1 from register s2 into it at 0xc000000000281d64 on one path (path condition not traced). migr_pagemove loads it at 0xc00000000027df0c and passes it as the third argument to a cmn_err call with level 0 on an error path. IP35 has the same pair: a store in migr_control_init (0xc00000000032e148) and a load in migr_pagemove (0xc00000000032bcc0).
numa_migr_vehicle.citation: 6.5.30 unix.IP27 migr_control_init (store 0xc000000000281d64) and migr_pagemove (load 0xc00000000027df0c); unix.IP35 migr_pagemove (load 0xc00000000032bcc0) and migr_control_init (store 0xc00000000032e148)

numa_migr_min_maxradius.role: Minimum maximum radius for a migration target, read as a 32-bit word. In IP27 migr_control_init, in the arm for default mode 4, the code calls physmem_maxradius (0xc000000000281610) and at 0xc000000000281628 compares its result in v0 with this word (slt): when v0 is less than the value, the byte at offset 0 of the record reached through the table pointer at +8 gets bits 0x30, otherwise bit 0x20. A second load at 0xc0000000002817bc stores the low byte of the value at offset 4 of that record. IP35 has one load in migr_control_init (0xc00000000032e0bc) that is not traced.

numa_migr_auto_migr_mech.role: Automatic migration mechanism switch, read as a boolean. migr_control_init loads it at 0xc0000000002818d8 and compares it with the constant 1 in s2; equality is one of the short-circuit tests of the same branch sequence as the user and coaldmigr mechanisms. A second load at 0xc0000000002819bc takes its low bit (andi 1), shifts it to bit 0x10 and merges it into the flag byte at record+8 after clearing that bit (mask 0xef). No read site in IP35 or IP30.

numa_migr_user_migr_mech.role: User-requested migration mechanism switch, read as a boolean. migr_control_init loads it at 0xc0000000002818e4 and compares it with the constant 1 in s2 (same branch sequence as auto and coaldmigr). A second load at 0xc0000000002819f0 takes its low bit, shifts it to bit 0x08 and merges it into the flag byte at record+8, clearing that bit first (mask 0xf7). No read site in IP35 or IP30.

numa_migr_coaldmigr_mech.role: Coalesced-migration mechanism switch, read as a boolean. migr_control_init loads it at 0xc0000000002818f0 and compares it with the constant 1 in s2. A second load at 0xc000000000281a24 takes its low bit, shifts it to bit 0x04 and merges it into the flag byte at record+8, clearing that bit first (mask 0xfb). No read site in IP35 or IP30.

numa_refcnt_default_mode.role: Default reference-count mode, a small integer. migr_control_init loads it at 0xc000000000281654, branches to 0xc000000000281dbc when it is zero and to 0xc000000000281e28 when it equals the constant 1 in s2; other values fall through to a further compare with 3. The arms are not traced. No read site in IP35 or IP30.

numa_refcnt_overflow_threshold.role: Reference-count overflow threshold, an integer that must lie in 0 to 100. migr_control_init loads it at 0xc000000000281738 and branches to 0xc000000000281f44 when it is negative (bltz) or 101 or more (slti 101, beq), the same bounds test as numa_migr_default_threshold. The accepted path is not traced. No read site in IP35 or IP30.

r10k_intervene.role: Enable flag for the R10000 cache-error intervention countdown. tick_actions reads it at 0xc000000000046294 and, when it is nonzero, decrements the countdown word at the fixed address 0xffffffffffffc7b0 (base $0, offset -14416); when the countdown reaches zero it reloads the countdown from r10k_check_count (0xc0000000000462dc). A second read at 0xc000000000046374 compares it with the constant 1 held in s7 and branches on equality. cont_nmi_dump reads it at 0xc000000000044db8 and branches to 0xc000000000044e38 unless it and r10k_progress_nmi are both nonzero. allowboot clears it to zero at 0xc0000000000443c0 when it is nonzero and a halfword flag at -26518($28) is nonzero. No read site in IP35 or IP30.

r10k_progress_nmi.role: Enable flag for the R10000 progress check, read as a boolean. tick_actions reads it at five sites (0xc000000000046390, 0xc0000000000464b4, 0xc0000000000464d0, 0xc000000000046550 and 0xc0000000000462e4); at 0xc000000000046390 a zero value skips an atomic increment (ll/sc) of the word at offset 1992 of a per-CPU record. At 0xc0000000000464d0 a nonzero value clears the word at offset 1992 of the same record and branches to 0xc000000000046318; a zero value goes to 0xc00000000004631c. cont_nmi_dump reads it at 0xc000000000044dc0 and branches to 0xc000000000044e38 when it is zero. No read site in IP35 or IP30.

r10k_check_count.role: Countdown period for the R10000 intervention check. alloc_cpupda copies it into the per-CPU record at offset 1968 (load 0xc0000000001e4014, store to 1968 of the record). tick_actions reloads the countdown word at the fixed address 0xffffffffffffc7b0 from it when the countdown reaches zero (load 0xc0000000000462dc, store 0xc0000000000462e0). No read site in IP35 or IP30.

r10k_progress_diff.role: Threshold, an 8-byte value, for the R10000 progress check. tick_actions loads it at 0xc000000000046364 and branches back to 0xc00000000004631c when the 64-bit difference computed just before it (dsubu at 0xc000000000046360) is less than the threshold (sltu). The difference is the doubleword read through the pointer in s4 (0xc000000000046354) minus the doubleword at offset 1464 of the record in s5 (0xc00000000004634c; the path is skipped when that word is zero or the first value is smaller). The unit of the difference is not identified. No read site in IP35 or IP30.

r10k_bpmode.role: R10000 mode selector, a small integer. mlreset loads it at 0xc000000000026154 and branches on zero (to 0xc0000000000261fc), on 1 (to 0xc00000000002620c) and on 2 (a later beq), so the value selects one of several arms. The four values 0, 1, 2 and 3 call branch_prediction_on, branch_prediction_fwd_not_taken, branch_prediction_off and branch_prediction_taken (arms at 0xc0000000000261fc, 0xc00000000002620c, 0xc00000000002621c, 0xc00000000002622c), each returning to 0xc000000000026184. Any other value falls to a branch on s0 at 0xc00000000002617c that goes to a printf call at 0xc0000000000264a0 when s0 is zero (a1 still holds the value); the printf message is not traced. The second load, at 0xc00000000002649c, is in the delay slot of the jump back to the compare chain (0xc000000000026158) after intrgroup_init on the path that starts at 0xc00000000002623c; it feeds the same chain and is not a printf path. No read site in IP35 or IP30.

dbe_recovery.role: Boolean that enables recovery after a double-bit memory error. Read in IP27 at pas_vfault (0xc000000000250b60, branch to 0xc000000000250d14 when nonzero, and further sites in the same routine), _pagefree_size (0xc0000000001aee74, branch to 0xc0000000001af100 when zero), and scache_pool_add (0xc0000000001cce28; when zero the routine goes straight to its setup at 0xc0000000001cce5c, when nonzero it also tests a flag bit of the word at offset 16 of its argument and returns early if the bit is set). The paths behind the branches are not traced. The IP35 build has the same reads, in pas_vfault, _pagefree_size and scache_pool_add.
dbe_recovery.citation: 6.5.30 unix.IP27 pas_vfault (0xc00000000024ef9c; load 0xc000000000250b60), _pagefree_size (0xc0000000001aede0; load 0xc0000000001aee74), scache_pool_add (0xc0000000001cce28; load 0xc0000000001cce28); unix.IP35 pas_vfault (0xc0000000002fedfc; load 0xc0000000002ff64c)

l2_sbe_check.role: Mask for the secondary-cache single-bit error check. Only the low byte is tested: counter_intr reads it at 0xc0000000000457fc, masks with 0xff and calls l2_sbe_intr only when the byte is nonzero; l2_sbe_init reads it at 0xc000000000055464 and tests the same low byte at 0xc00000000005547c before its setup. counter_intr also tests bit 0 at 0xc000000000045818 (andi 1, loop back when set). l2_sbe_sched tests bit 0x100 at 0xc000000000055864 (andi) and calls cmn_err when it is set on the path described under l2_sbe_reset_sec. sched reads it at two more sites. The default 0x000c keeps the low byte nonzero. The remaining bits, and the reads in sched, are not traced.

l2_sbe_reset_sec.role: Count threshold for the secondary-cache single-bit error reset, read as a word; the unit is not established (the 6.5.22 default is 60, and the name says seconds). l2_sbe_sched loads it at three sites. At 0xc000000000055844 it is compared for equality (0xc00000000005586c) with a call counter at gp-32332 that the routine increments on each call while a flag word at gp-32328 is nonzero; on equality the flag is cleared and, when bit 0x100 of l2_sbe_check is set, a cmn_err call at 0xc000000000055930 follows. At 0xc000000000055894 and 0xc00000000005590c it is the reload for a loop over the processors: for each valid entry it compares the value with the doubleword at offset 1024 of the entry (bne at 0xc0000000000558c8), increments that doubleword, and on equality calls l2_sbe_start_perfcnt for the current processor or cpuaction for another one. How often l2_sbe_sched runs is not traced.

sbe_max_per_page.role: Per-page single-bit error limit. memerror_sbe_intr increments a count word at offset 16 of a record (addiu +1, sw at 0xc00000000004a580), then tests it for equality with this word (beq at 0xc00000000004a588). Equality takes the branch to 0xc00000000004a754. The action on equality is not traced. IP35 has two sites in memerror_sbe_intr (0xc00000000006c34c and 0xc00000000006c490).
sbe_max_per_page.citation: 6.5.30 unix.IP27 memerror_sbe_intr (0xc000000000049e74; loads 0xc00000000004a584, 0xc00000000004a73c); unix.IP35 memerror_sbe_intr (0xc00000000006bce8; loads 0xc00000000006c34c, 0xc00000000006c490)

sbe_maxout.role: Single-bit error limit, read as a word and compared for equality with the same count word that sbe_max_per_page uses in memerror_sbe_intr (beq at 0xc00000000004a590 branches to 0xc00000000004a7cc on equality). The second IP27 read, at 0xc00000000004a744, is in the delay slot of the bne at 0xc00000000004a740 and loads into a1. When the count differs from sbe_max_per_page the branch is taken and the code at 0xc00000000004a81c compares a1 with the count (beq to 0xc00000000004a7d0), so the read is used; on the fall-through path the next instruction (dsrl a1 at 0xc00000000004a748) overwrites it, so it is unused only there. IP35 has two reads in memerror_sbe_intr (0xc00000000006c354 and 0xc00000000006c498) that are not traced.

sbe_mem_verbose.role: Verbose flag for single-bit memory error logging. page_discard_enqueue tests bit 0 of the word (andi 1, bne at 0xc0000000001b09e4) and takes the branch to 0xc0000000001b09fc when it is set; the message the branch leads to is not traced. The IP35 build has one read in page_discard_enqueue (0xc00000000025f1a4 region).
sbe_mem_verbose.citation: 6.5.30 unix.IP27 page_discard_enqueue (0xc0000000001b0934; load 0xc0000000001b09dc); unix.IP35 page_discard_enqueue (0xc00000000025f0fc; load 0xc00000000025f1a4)

dump_hub_info.role: Level of hub register dumping. dump_hub_data loads it at 0xc000000000219dc0 and skips the register dump (branch to 0xc000000000219dec) when the value is zero or negative (blez); otherwise it calls dump_hub_registers at 0xc000000000219dd0. The level values above 0 are not traced. IP35 has one read in dump_hub_data (0xc0000000002c90e4 region).
dump_hub_info.citation: 6.5.30 unix.IP27 dump_hub_data (0xc000000000219dc0; load 0xc000000000219dc0, call 0xc000000000219dd0); unix.IP35 dump_hub_data (0xc0000000002c90e4)
